args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, affecting
versions <2.9.4). Bump the pin to 2.9.4, the first fixed release
on the 2.x line, to avoid major-version breaking changes.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades the fastjson pin from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, affecting fastjson <2.9.4 (and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0).

## Details
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4` (first fixed release on the 2.x line per the advisory; avoids breaking changes from the 3.x major version).
- No source code changes required.
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.
args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
